llm_request:
Draft a professional follow-up email to a client that includes: 
1. A friendly closing statement ("Nice to talk with you") 
2. Mention of following up on their account 
3. An invitation to contact the user with questions 
4. Use the anonymized name <PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON> in the signature 
5. Maintain a polite and professional tone 
6. Avoid any personal or sensitive information 

Format the response as a complete email with subject line and body.
llm_response:
**Subject:** Follow-up regarding your account

Dear [Client Name],

It was nice to talk with you recently. I am writing to follow up on your account and ensure that everything is proceeding smoothly. Please let me know if there is anything further you need from our end. 

If you have any questions or require additional assistance, please do not hesitate to contact me directly. 

Best regards,

<PRESIDIO_ANONYMIZED_PERSON>
